arxiv-2012-07590.title: Quantum teleportation and entanglement swapping with long baseline in outer space
arxiv-2012-07590.creator: Shih-Yuin Lin, B. L. Hu
arxiv-2012-07590.description: Abstract Quantum information experiments applying quantum optics in outer space with a very long baseline may have advantages over the current earth-bound experiments or the earth-to-satellite experiments because they can minimize the loss in light transmission and maximize the gain in time resolution.

arxiv-2107-09032.title: Sustainability of Global Economy as a Quantum Circuit
arxiv-2107-09032.creator: Antonino Claudio Bonan
arxiv-2107-09032.description: Abstract In economy, viewed as a quantum system working as a circuit, each process at the microscale is a quantum gate among agents. The global configuration of economy is addressed by optimizing the sustainability of the whole circuit. This is done in terms of geodesics, starting from some approximations.

arxiv-2108-13160.title: NOMA Assisted Multi-MEC Offloading for IoVT Networks
arxiv-2108-13160.creator: Fengqian Guo, Hancheng Lu, Bo Li, Dingxuan Li, Chang Wen Chen
arxiv-2108-13160.description: Abstract Abstract Nowadays, Internet of Video Things (IoVT) grows rapidly in terms of quantity and computation demands. In spite of the higher local computation capability on visual processing compared with conventional Internet of Things devices, IoVT devices need to offload partial visual processing tasks to the mobile edge computing (MEC) server wirelessly due to its larger computation demands.

arxiv-2202-04693.title: Modelling Autler-Townes splitting and acoustically induced transparency in a waveguide loaded with resonant channels
arxiv-2202-04693.creator: Richard Porter, Kim Pham, Agnès Maurel
arxiv-2202-04693.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Richard Porter, Kim Pham, Agnès Maurel. We study acoustic wave propagation in a waveguide loaded with two resonant side-branch channels. In the low frequency regime, one-dimensional models are derived in which the effect of the channels are reduced to jump conditions across the junction. When the separation distance is on the scale of the wavelength, which is the case that is usually considered, the jump conditions involve a single channel and acoustically induced transparency (AIT) occurs due to out-of-phase interferences between the two junctions.

arxiv-2212-12521.title: Quantum-Referenced Spontaneous Emission Tomography
arxiv-2212-12521.creator: I. I. Faruque, B. M. Burridge, M. Banic, M. Borghi, J. E. Sipe, J. G. Rarity, J. Barreto
arxiv-2212-12521.description: Abstract We present a method of tomography that measures the joint spectral phase (JSP) of spontaneously emitted photon pairs originating from a largely uncharacterized “target” source. We use quantum interference between our target source and a reference source to extract the JSP with four spectrally resolved measurements, in a process that we call quantum-referenced spontaneous emission tomography (Q-SpET).

arxiv-2305-06936.title: An Option-Dependent Analysis of Regret Minimization Algorithms in Finite-Horizon Semi-Markov Decision Processes
arxiv-2305-06936.creator: Gianluca Drappo, Alberto Maria Metelli, Marcello Restelli
arxiv-2305-06936.description: Abstract A large variety of real-world Reinforcement Learning (RL) tasks is characterized by a complex and heterogeneous structure that makes end-to-end (or flat) approaches hardly applicable or even infeasible. Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning (HRL) provides general solutions to address these problems thanks to a convenient multi-level decomposition of the tasks, making their solution accessible.

arxiv-2310-00994.title: A Uniform One-Dimensional Fragment with Alternation of Quantifiers
arxiv-2310-00994.creator: Emanuel Kieroński
arxiv-2310-00994.description: Abstract The uniform one-dimensional fragment of first-order logic was introduced a few years ago as a generalization of the two-variable fragment of first-order logic to contexts involving relations of arity greater than two. Quantifiers in this logic are used in blocks, each block consisting only of existential quantifiers or only of universal quantifiers.

arxiv-2310-16522.title: Enrique Álvarez, Jesús Anero and Irene Sánchez-Ruiz.
arxiv-2310-16522.creator: Departamento de Física Teórica and Instituto de Física Teórica,
arxiv-2310-16522.description: Abstract It is well-known that in unimodular gravity (UG) the cosmological constant is not sourced by a constant energy density, but rather appears as some sort of integration constant. In this work we try to flesh this out by studying in some detail a couple of examples, one from cosmology and the other from gravitational collapse.

arxiv-2403-07831.title: Utilizing Load Shifting for Optimal Compressor Sequencing in Industrial Refrigeration
arxiv-2403-07831.creator: Rohit Konda, Vikas Chandan, Jesse Crossno, Blake Pollard, Dan Walsh, Rick Bohonek, Jason R. Marden
arxiv-2403-07831.description: Abstract The ubiquity and energy needs of industrial refrigeration has prompted several research studies investigating various control opportunities for reducing energy demand. This work focuses on one such opportunity, termed compressor sequencing , which entails intelligently selecting the operational state of the compressors to service the required refrigeration load with the least possible work.

arxiv-2407-08456.title: Propagation and non-reciprocity in time-modulated diffusion through the lens of high-order homogenization
arxiv-2407-08456.creator: M. Touboul 1,2 , B. Lombard 3 , R.C. Assier 4 , S. Guenneau 2,5 and R.V. Craster 1,2,6
arxiv-2407-08456.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by M. Touboul 1,2 , B. Lombard 3 , R.C. Assier 4 , S. Guenneau 2,5 and R.V. Craster 1,2,6. The homogenization procedure developed here is conducted on a laminate with periodic space-time modulation on the fine scale: at leading order, this modulation creates convection in the low-wavelength regime if both parameters are modulated.

arxiv-2407-11977.title: Building Better AI Agents: A Provocation on the Utilisation of Persona in LLM-based Conversational Agents Conference: ACM Conversational User Interfaces 2024; July 8–10, 2024; Luxembourg, Luxembourg ACM Conversational User Interfaces 2024 (CUI ’24), July 8–10, 2024, Luxembourg, Luxembourg DOI: 10.11

arxiv-2407-11977.description: Abstract . The incorporation of Large Language Models (LLMs) such as the GPT series into diverse sectors including healthcare, education, and finance marks a significant evolution in the field of artificial intelligence (AI). The increasing demand for personalised applications motivated the design of conversational agents (CAs) to possess distinct personas.

arxiv-2411-19132.title: Conformal Prediction for Distribution-free Optimal Control of Linear Stochastic Systems Thanks: This work was supported by the Swedish Research Council (VR), the Knut & Alice Wallenberg Foundation (KAW), the Horizon Europe Grant SymAware and the ERC Consolidator Grant LEAFHOUND. Thanks: E.E. Vlahaki
arxiv-2411-19132.creator: Eleftherios E. Vlahakis, Lars Lindemann, Pantelis Sopasakis, and
arxiv-2411-19132.description: Abstract We address an optimal control problem for linear stochastic systems with unknown noise distributions and joint chance constraints using conformal prediction. Our approach involves designing a feedback controller to maintain an error system within a prediction region (PR). We define PRs as sublevel sets of a nonconformity score over error trajectories, enabling the handling of joint chance constraints.

arxiv-2509-21461.title: Stochastic analysis of ultra-high energy cosmic ray interactions This work employed the software packages Astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2013 ; Astropy Collaboration et al. 2018 ; Astropy Collaboration et al. 2022 ) , Matplotlib ( Hunter 2007 ) , Numpy ( Harris et al. 2020 ) , Scipy ( Virtan
arxiv-2509-21461.creator: Leonel Morejon, Karl-Heinz Kampert
arxiv-2509-21461.description: Abstract Photonuclear interactions between ultra-high-energy cosmic ray (UHECR) nuclei and surrounding photon fields are key to understanding the connection between the compositions observed at Earth and those emitted from the sources. These interactions can completely disintegrate a nucleus of iron over trajectory lengths of a few and up to hundreds of megaparsecs, depending on the energy of the UHECR.

arxiv-2601-14079.title: VENI: Variational Encoder for Natural Illumination
arxiv-2601-14079.creator: Paul Walker, James A. D. Gardner, Andreea Ardelean, William A. P. Smith, Bernhard Egger
arxiv-2601-14079.description: Abstract Inverse rendering is an ill-posed problem, but priors like illumination priors, can simplify it. Existing work either disregards the spherical and rotation-equivariant nature of illumination environments or does not provide a well-behaved latent space. We propose a rotation-equivariant variational autoencoder that models natural illumination on the sphere without relying on 2D projections.

arxiv-2602-19620.title: Rules or Weights? Comparing User Understanding of Explainable AI Techniques with the Cognitive XAI-Adaptive Model Conference: 31st International Conference on Intelligent User Interfaces; March 23–26, 2026; Paphos, Cyprus 31st International Conference on Intelligent User Interfaces (IUI ’26), March
arxiv-2602-19620.creator: Louth Bin Rawshan, Zhuoyu Wang, Brian Y Lim
arxiv-2602-19620.description: Abstract . Rules and Weights are popular XAI techniques for explaining AI decisions. Yet, it remains unclear how to choose between them, lacking a cognitive framework to compare their interpretability. In an elicitation user study on forward and counterfactual decision tasks, we identified 7 reasoning strategies of interpreting three XAI Schemas—weights, rules, and their hybrid.

pmc-10594707.title: Prognostic significance of HLA-G in patients with colorectal cancer: a meta-analysis and bioinformatics analysis
pmc-10594707.creator: Yingying Zhang, Siying He, Lisha Yu, Chao Shi, Yanyue Zhang, Shiyue Tang
pmc-10594707.description: PurposeHuman leukocyte antigen-G (HLA-G) has been reported to be aberrantly expressed in colorectal cancer (CRC); however, its prognostic value remains controversial. Hence, our meta-analysis aims to assess the prognostic value of HLA-G in CRC patients based on published literature and The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA) datasets.

pmc-10612515.title: Promotion of Hair Regrowth in Androgenetic Alopecia with Supplemented Erzhi Wan: Exploring Its Mechanism Using Network Pharmacology and Molecular Docking
pmc-10612515.creator: Chen Ji, Jun Ma, Chengcheng Feng, Hongliu Zhu, Yanwei Gao, Jun Huang, Hui Shen, Yuegang Wei
pmc-10612515.description: PurposeSupplemented Erzhi Wan (SEZW) is a Traditional Chinese Medicine commonly used in the treatment of androgenetic alopecia (AGA). This study aims to verify the effectiveness of SEZW for the treatment of AGA in mice and explore the potential molecular mechanisms underlying its function using network pharmacology and molecular docking.

pmc-10668554.title: Assessment of the inclusion of a feed additive of sodium humate derived from freshwater sapropel in diets for broiler chickens
pmc-10668554.creator: Liga Proskina, Dace Barzdina, Anda Valdovska, Irina Pilvere, Ilze Vircava, Sallija Cerina, Sandijs Meskis
pmc-10668554.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Background and Aim:Poultry production is the fastest growing livestock industry in the world, as the rapid growth of and efficient absorption of feed by poultry ensure the production of poultry meat with a relatively low carbon footprint. Seeking new ways to increase livestock productivity as well as poultry product quality, the number of research studies on the use of humic substances of various origins in livestock farming has increased significantly, emphasizing the role of feed additives derived from local resources.

pmc-11658127.title: Evaluating data requirements for high-quality haplotype-resolved genomes for creating robust pangenome references
pmc-11658127.creator: Prasad Sarashetti, Josipa Lipovac, Filip Tomas, Mile Šikić, Jianjun Liu
pmc-11658127.description: BackgroundLong-read technologies from Pacific Biosciences (PacBio) and Oxford Nanopore Technologies (ONT) have transformed genomics research by providing diverse data types like HiFi, Duplex, and ultra-long ONT. Despite recent strides in achieving haplotype-phased gapless genome assemblies using long-read technologies, concerns persist regarding the representation of genetic diversity, prompting the development of pangenome references.

pmc-11712603.title: Amyloid burden and APOE modify sex differences in estimated meta‐temporal region tau onset age
pmc-11712603.creator: Margo B Heston, Karly Cody, Jordan P Teague, Elena Ruiz De Chavez, Jacob Morse, Yuetiva Deming, Corinne D Engelman, Richard J Chappell, Rebecca E Langhough, Carey E Gleason, Lindsay R Clark, Megan L Zuelsdorff, Tobey J Betthauser
pmc-11712603.description: BackgroundRecent advances in Alzheimer’s disease (AD) temporal biomarker modeling have revealed considerable heterogeneity in age at amyloid onset, and recently we and others identified sex and APOE differences in tau onset age and subsequent dementia development. Here we assessed whether amyloid burden, APOE‐e4 dose, and sex interact to predict estimated T+ onset age (ETOA).

pmc-12519250.title: Prognostic value of lymph node staging systems in gastric cancer patients undergoing laparoscopic surgery: A case-series in Vietnam
pmc-12519250.creator: Kien Quach Van, Tam Nguyen Thi Thanh
pmc-12519250.description: IntroductionLymph node metastasis is the most important prognostic factor for gastric cancer (GC). While the pN staging system is widely used, it does not account for the total number of dissected lymph nodes, potentially leading to stage migration in patients with suboptimal lymphadenectomy.

pmc-12607230.title: Skin care knowledge, attitudes and practices: a comparative study between patients with atopic dermatitis and healthy individuals
pmc-12607230.creator: Danni Wang, Xinfeng Pan, Jianfeng Wang
pmc-12607230.description: BackgroundAtopic dermatitis (AD) is a chronic, relapsing inflammatory skin disease that significantly impacts patient quality of life and demands specific skin care practices. This study aimed to investigate the knowledge, attitudes, and practices (KAP) related to skin care among patients with AD and the practices (P) concerning skin care among the healthy individuals.

pmc-12827667.title: Mechanistic insights into the anti-neuroinflammatory effects of cassia obtusifolia in Parkinson’s disease: a network pharmacology-based study
pmc-12827667.creator: Xinfu Lian, Yongjun Bai, Rong Xie, Wang Du, Lingbo Ma, Yuqian Jiang
pmc-12827667.description: BackgroundParkinson’s disease (PD) is a chronic neurodegenerative disorder that is closely associated with neuroinflammation, yet effective anti-inflammatory therapies remain limited. This study aimed to elucidate the potential mechanisms of Cassia obtusifolia in mitigating PD-associated neuroinflammatory responses.MethodsNetwork pharmacology was employed to identify bioactive compounds, candidate targets, and enriched pathways, followed by protein–protein interaction (PPI) analysis and molecular docking.

pmc-12966414.title: PGC-1α protects against MASH via Tim23-dependent inhibition of DRP1-mediated ferroptosis
pmc-12966414.creator: Yanmian Zhao, Linzhong Zhang, Bairong Li, Menghan Liu, Yanting Zhang, Teng Li, Shoubin Ning, Xiuying Zhang
pmc-12966414.description: Peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma coactivator 1α (PGC-1α) is crucial for mitochondrial function and biogenesis. However, whether and how PGC-1α can regulate hepatocyte ferroptosis during the pathogenic process of metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH) has not been clarified. Hepatocyte ferroptosis was assessed in the liver of MASH patients and in vivo and in vitro MASH models.

pmc-13137765.title: Donation After Circulatory Death in Pediatric Heart Transplantation
pmc-13137765.creator: Sarah Dudley Grorud, Michael D. Porter, Taufiek Konrad Rajab, R. Jerome Dixon, Michael McCulloch, Firezer Haregu
pmc-13137765.description: PurposeDonation after circulatory death (DCD) is an emerging heart transplantation (HT) strategy with improved waitlist and comparable post‐transplant outcomes to donation after brain death (DBD) in adults. Pediatric DCD‐HT is underutilized but gaining broader adoption. We assessed the impact of DCD listing on waitlist outcomes and graft survival in pediatric HT.

pmc-13286799.title: Synergistic effects of AWD irrigation and potassium application on rice yield and paddy field greenhouse gas emissions
pmc-13286799.creator: Dandan Wu, Yinghao Li, Zhengyuqi Ma, Shujun Wang, Taotao Chen, Hongtao Zou, Jingjun Li, Yang Gao

pmc-13473582.title: Lineage topology, replication kinetics and cell cycle synchronization reveal regulated growth dynamics in human bone marrow stromal cell colonies
pmc-13473582.creator: Alessandro Allegrezza, Riccardo Beschi, Domenico Caudo, Andrea Cavagna, Alessandro Corsi, Antonio Culla, Samantha Donsante, Giuseppe Giannicola, Irene Giardina, Giorgio Gosti, Tomás S Grigera, Stefania Melillo, Biagio Palmisano, Leonardo Parisi, Lorena Postiglione, Mara Riminucci, Francesco Saverio
pmc-13473582.description: Bone marrow stromal cells (BMSC) – which include skeletal stem cells – are a promising tool in regenerative medicine. However, their heterogeneous and unpredictable in vivo behaviour remains a critical barrier preventing the development of standardized therapeutic approaches for skeletal tissue regeneration.

pmc-13654121.title: Atrial and ventricular mechanical dysfunction and myocardial injury predict long-term outcomes in hypertrophic cardiomyopathy: a retrospective cohort study
pmc-13654121.creator: Sheng-Liang Liu, Xue-Dong Wang, Ye Li, Xuan-Lang Zhang, Yun-Ling Li, Guo-Kun Wang, Mao-Mao Zhang, Yan-Ming Zhao, Xia Gu, Bo Yu
pmc-13654121.description: BackgroundLeft ventricular (LV) diastolic dysfunction is a hallmark of hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) and imposes chronic pressure overload on the left atrium, leading to progressive atrial remodeling and functional impairment. Conventional left atrial (LA) volumetric indices reflect comparatively advanced structural alterations and are incapable of identifying early functional deterioration.
